title: How a Slow Cooker Works in 60 Seconds 🍲⏳ #shorts
description:
A slow cooker is a heavy ceramic pot sitting in a metal shell with heating coils wrapped around its sides. Low heat soaks in slowly for hours, the lid traps steam, and tough meat turns tender as collagen melts into gelatin. Follow Inside 60 for a new "how it works" explained in 60 seconds.

#slowcooker #howitworks #shorts

steps.label: Hook
steps.text: A slow cooker makes tough meat tender by staying *below boiling* for *hours*.

steps.label: Coils
steps.text: Inside the metal shell, *heating coils* wrap around the sides and bottom.

steps.label: Crock
steps.text: A thick *ceramic crock* soaks up that heat and spreads it gently and evenly.

steps.label: Low heat
steps.text: On *low*, the food slowly creeps up to around *200°F*, just under a boil.

steps.label: Lid
steps.text: The heavy *lid* traps steam, so moisture drips back down instead of escaping.

steps.label: Tender
steps.text: Hours of gentle heat melt tough *collagen* in meat into soft *gelatin*.

steps.label: Recap
steps.text: Gentle heat, *time*, tender. Follow Inside 60 for more.
